'''Polanis wine''' was one of the best [[Wine/Legends|wine]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. It was produced on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Polanis]], in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
